tasks.title: Look at the big claws
tasks.message: A male's claws are thick and strong, for fighting and for keeping safe.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a male mangrove crab. His claws are thick and strong.

tasks.title: Count its legs
tasks.message: Crabs walk on eight legs. The back two are flat, like little paddles for swimming.
tasks.subtitle: Eight legs for walking, and the back two are flat paddles for swimming.

tasks.title: Help it
tasks.message: The mangroves at Mai Po are where mangrove crabs live.
tasks.subtitle: Mangroves are where these crabs live. Thank you!
